Hello Yves, 

I have three vectors representing the factorial loadings for a personality scale. These vectors were reported in an old journal (1978), and probably at that time it was not customary to report also the eigen values for each retained factor. 
I need to compute ”post-factum” the eigen values for this scale, in order to compare with eigen values that were reported, for the same scale, in more recent articles. 

Thank you very much!

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: how to compute eigen from factor loadings?
parts:
Are the factors correlated or orthogonal?  If orthogonal, and if all terms are standardized, and if the model fits in an absolute or chi-square sense, then the sum of squared Loadings, factor by factor, will approximate the corresponding eigenvalue.  But if the factors covary, then there is no one-to-one correspondence between factors and eigenvalues.  Either way, though, this will only be an approximation to what you would get if you had the covariance matrix itself.
     The best book on the technical details of factor analysis (IMHO) is Stan Mulaik's.  A second edition came out in 2010 or so.  Totally recommend it.
--Ed Rigdon
